subject: WRITE statement
notes: GR28: 'If, during the successful execution of a WRITE statement with the NOT END-OF-PAGE phrase, the end-of-page condition does not occur, then after execution of the input-output operation, control is transferred to imperative-statement-2 of the NOT END-OF-PAGE phrase. If control is returned from imperative-statement-2, control is then transferred to the end of the WRITE statement.' (cite.py --check 14.9.51.4 -> OK rule 28). EmitWrite snapshots the connector status before the FILE STATUS store and USE hook, then renders `if (successful && EndOfPage) {AT} else if (successful) {NOT}` — the NOT arm runs only on a successful write without the condition, after the operation, and falls to the end of the statement. Both orders of the phrases parse (conditionalPhrases' choice indicators, §5.2.6.4). Goldens conformance:cases/13.18.34-LINAGE/pb686_linage_gr26_boundary and conformance:cases/13.18.34-LINAGE/pb686_linage_gr26_boundary_85 print 'NO-EOP' on exactly the writes that land inside the page body (spec-derived per the PB686 determination).
